coordinate_system.orientation_notes: X is the horizontal axis of rotation and the axis of both the central bore and external gear cylinder. Y is vertical in the main section view, and Z is normal to the page/cut plane.

features.description: Outer cylindrical extent (tip diameter) of the gear with entry chamfers on both edges.

features.name: Right side face

relationships.detail: Central bore axis and outer gear/tip cylinder are both defined on the X axis of rotation.
Runout control on the left side flat face references Datum A, defined by the central bore axis.
Left and right lateral gear faces are opposing side faces of the gear body.
The central through bore opens through the left side face.
The central through bore opens through the right side face.

datums.description: Axis of the central internal bore (Ø24 H7)

datum_scheme.datum_hierarchy_notes: Datum A is defined by the axis of the central Ø24 H7 internal bore. The left side face runout control references Datum A.
